observed: The zero/one/two-slot branches fill remaining frame-0x60/-0x68/-0x548 temporaries with raw 2, respectively; all four s311 exits converge at 0x1264db.
r13 retains the candidate stack origin from s311. The join reads [r13+0xd50]->byte+0x951 and conditionally [r13+0xde8]; it saves r9 in r14 and r8 in frame-0x588 on both classification branches.
One branch stores [r13+0xde8] into frame-0x550; another stores the original frame-0x60 value. The remaining branch passes &frame-0x550, r13, &frame-0x60 to opaque call 0xd2200 at 0x126979.
At 0x12697e, r13 and &frame-0x548 are passed to opaque call 0x5f50 at 0x126988. Reaching this site after 0x126979 requires an unproved normal machine return.
stack_join.not_proved: The shared owner register is a static argument relation, not defining scope, register4, allocation generation, AVM argument meaning or activation identity.

observed: At the s311 call site, rdi is page(field_address)+8 dereferenced, rsi is carrier+0x48, and edx is zero. Here incoming rdi/rsi are saved in r15/r14.
The helper compares rsi against incoming rdi fields +0x880/+0x888, reads/writes +0x8d0/+0x8d8, and has two opaque calls to 0x994170.
The backward edge 0x98ba21->0x98b9b0 can repeat page subtraction by 0x1000. No iteration bound is established.
Different paths produce zero or computed address candidates in rax and share machine RET 0x98ba8b. The s311 caller copies rax into rsi for the second helper.
carrier_lookup.not_proved: No allocation owner or finite lifetime is identified. RET existence proves neither termination nor a live return, and nested callees may have further effects.

observed: Incoming rdi/rsi/rdx/rcx are saved as r15/r14/r12/rbx. At the s311 caller these correspond to page-derived candidate, first-helper result, carrier+0x48, &frame-0x58 (raw temporary 10).
The helper reads [r12], conditionally decrements dword [(value & ~7)+8] and can update page-derived fields +0x2280/+0x2290 and an indexed slot; the alternate path calls 0x9929e0.

It then reads [rbx], conditionally increments/changes dword [(new_value & ~7)+8] and can clear a page-derived indexed slot. It conditionally calls 0x98da30 with saved incoming rdi/rsi after testing byte [r15+0x751].
The final store at 0x12f6fb writes rbx to [r12], then reaches machine RET 0x12f707. At this call site the direct destination is carrier+0x48, conditional on reaching that instruction.
carrier_store.not_proved: Masks and raw counters are not named AVM types or retain/release semantics. Nested-call effects, preservation and exceptional exits are unknown.

observed: No direct operand in these four bounded windows reads the original dispatcher frame-0x160 descriptor origin. Helper rbp is a new native frame and must not be identified with the dispatcher rbp.
descriptor_boundary.not_proved: Absence of a direct operand does not prove non-aliasing or no indirect descriptor access. Stack owner, selected carrier and descriptor ownership/lifetime relation remains unknown.
